Epoch lifecycle and voter initialization functions with workspace and alignment checks.

# Purpose
This file implements the lifecycle and setup logic for an `fd_epoch_t` object. It defines functions to create, join, leave, and delete an epoch record in shared memory, with checks for `NULL` pointers, alignment, workspace membership, and the `FD_EPOCH_MAGIC` value. The [`fd_epoch_new`](<#fd_epoch_new>) function allocates and clears the memory layout for the epoch and its voter table, then initializes the epoch fields and stores workspace-relative addresses for later access.

The file also defines epoch data initialization and cleanup. The [`fd_epoch_init`](<#fd_epoch_init>) function sets the epoch slot range, walks the `vote_accounts` list, and inserts each vote account with nonzero stake into the epoch voter table while setting vote state fields to `FD_SLOT_NULL`. It also accumulates `total_stake` across all vote accounts. The [`fd_epoch_fini`](<#fd_epoch_fini>) function clears the voter table and resets `total_stake`.
